title: Supplementary material to Rosenthal et al., RNA-seq reveals cooperative metabolic interactions between two termite-gut spirochete species in co-culture
locator: PDF page1, Supplementary Figure1; PDF page2, contents of supplementary tables1–4; PDF pages3–207, gene/transcript tables.

facts.figure_scope: The first PDF page diagrams biosynthetic pathways involving biotin, pyridoxal/phosphorylated pyridoxal and coenzymeA.
facts.table_scope: The contents and tables concern differential gene expression, unexpressed genes, sequencing samples and expression measurements.
facts.reagent_scope_limit: Pathway compounds and gene annotations do not specify the experimental B6 mixture proportions or select the corrinoid supplied to a particular culture.
facts.positive_methods_evidence_elsewhere: The separate directly retrieved PMC article methods support the named B6 reagents and four alternative B12 forms. This supplement is not their formulation evidence.

interpretation_limit: Limits the relevance of the supplement: pathway/gene-expression content is not stock or supplied-form identification. No B6/corrinoid formulation conclusion depends on retaining the complete tables.
capture_note: Bounded paraphrased facts after inspecting the retained PDF text and page locations. This JSON is an extraction, not the downloaded HTTP response; the complete PDF and text remain private with their exact hashes and acquisition metadata.
